job.project: SAMPLE - Coring in LG floor plant room for tank separation
job.scope: This is a sample job to demonstrate the app; all values and images are illustrative. MHS+ Project Management Services was appointed to locate reinforcement and embedded services at the proposed core position in the LG floor plant room, prior to coring for tank separation works.

locations.description: LG plant room, proposed 150 mm core
locations.targets: Metallic conduit at approx. 140 mm, running E-W
locations.conclusion: Core feasible at the marked position, clear of top bars and the conduit.
locations.result: A 600 x 600 mm C-scan grid was carried out at the proposed core position. A two-way top reinforcement mesh was detected at approximately 150 mm centres, with concrete cover of 45 to 50 mm, based on a calibrated dielectric constant of 7.0 (wave velocity 0.113 m/ns) derived from hyperbola fitting. A metallic conduit was identified at a depth of approximately 140 mm, running east-west. The slab underside was observed at approximately 250 mm. No anomalies were observed. The core is considered feasible at the marked position, clear of the top reinforcement and the conduit.

summary: This sample illustrates the report output. A GPR investigation was carried out at one location in the LG floor plant room to locate reinforcement and embedded services prior to coring. A two-way top mesh at approximately 150 mm centres with 45 to 50 mm cover and a metallic conduit at approximately 140 mm were detected. The proposed core at L-01 was found to be clear to proceed at the marked position. Readers should refer to the limitations section of this report.
